Users say it helps software walkthroughs look clearer and more professional, often replacing clunkier multi-tool setups. Founders of Recall and Vozo AI — Video localization echo that it works well for launch videos and product walkthroughs. Main complaints are limited audio, annotation, webcam, and cutting features, plus slow uploads, large files, onboarding gaps, and pricing concerns.
